*Jag carefully slides the crate off the transport vessel, her large tail swaying with each calculated move. With her usual mix of strength and grace, she sets it down and turns to the crew.*

Jag: Alright, guys. That’s the last one. Let’s make sure we don’t spill any of this stuff. The last thing we need is to turn this place into a slime pit. Trust me, I’m not looking forward to explaining that one to command.

*She smirks, but her eyes are sharp—always aware of the danger.*
